name: Change Text in Image
tagline: AI photo text editor — change text in an image while matching font and style.
description: Change Text in Image is an online AI editor that lets you replace wording in photos, screenshots, posters, and ads without Photoshop. Draw a box around the text, enter the replacement, and the AI matches font, color, and style while repairing the background. Also supports remove and blur modes. Freemium: 1 free generation after signup; one-time credit packs Starter $14.90 / Pro $26.90 / Studio $39.90; no subscription; credits never expire. No manual font/size/color controls.
